notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
